title: THE HOT SEAT: Copy, Paste & Consequences — The Notes Don’t Lie… Or Do They?
description: When documentation gets messy: join a mentorship conversation on copying, pasting, duplicating notes, professional judgment, and ethical documentation. Clinicians can volunteer de-identified documentation dilemmas for discussion. Do not include client identifiers.

title: BRAIDS TO FADES — Beyond the Barber Chair: Culture, Consent & the Ethics of Hair Care in ABA
description: 1 BACB Ethics CEU for BCBAs and BCaBAs. Join Dr. Tranika Jefferson, PhD, BCBA-D, LBA, IBA; Miss Dee; and Ronald Shepherd to explore culturally responsive hair-care goals, client assent and autonomy, individualized grooming strategies, and collaboration with caregivers and barbers.
